scenes.summary: You encounter a Tianshi disciple named Lin Ke near the Ecological Research Station, who is conducting a startup test on the Tianshi Pillar. However, the classmates assisting him with the auxiliary pillars are absent due to unforeseen circumstances. You decide to help him complete the test.

lines.text: What should we do... Lu Ze and the others are swamped too. At this rate...
Uh, hello. My name's Lin Ke. I'm a Tianshi disciple researching Xiranite devices. I'm running a startup test on an experimental Tianshi Pillar.
I originally asked a classmate from our group to help out. I was supposed to monitor the data from the Tianshi Pillar here, while he handled activating the auxiliary pillar.
But he picked the worst time to injure his arm... I can't find anyone to replace him on such short notice. If we can't complete this experiment, my research project this year will be...
Wait, really? It's really simple! You'll just need to activate the six auxiliary pillars in sequence!
Thank you so much! I'll await your news here.
Oh right! Before you go, make sure to register your info at the ⟦key|Tianshi Pillar⟧ so I can grant you access.

options: What's going on? You look pretty worried.
How exactly should it be done? Perhaps I can give it a try.

r: What's going on? You look pretty worried.
How exactly should it be done? Perhaps I can give it a try.

scenes.summary: You tell Lin Ke about the successful results after activating all auxiliary pillars. Lin Ke's Tianshi Pillar startup test has now reached its final phase.

lines.text: Finally we can move to the next phase! I'll send another command to all auxiliary pillars to confirm their current status.
Endmin, please ⟦key|activate the Tianshi Pillar⟧ so I can collect all the data.
Thank you so much! I'm getting signals that all auxiliary pillars are activated properly... You really saved my thesis!

scenes.summary: Lin Ke successfully completes his Tianshi Pillar startup test. He can finally continue with his project now, and you offer him your blessings.

lines.text: The Tianshi Pillar is officially activated ... and the final data's in too.
First real-world Tianshi Pillar test confirmed successful!
Yep! Now we can finally make progress on this research project...
Anyway, thanks a ton! You really saved my skin back there.
By the way, our instructor recently granted us some research funding. Please accept this portion as a small token of our gratitude.
Data from all six auxiliary pillars received.
Though we still need to analyze the data further, you've already tackled the hardest part. The rest should be smooth sailing!

options: Congratulations, you've obtained all the data you wanted?
You're welcome. Good luck with your project.

r: Congratulations, you've obtained all the data you wanted?
You're welcome. Good luck with your project.
